title: Stage-4 spec-coverage sidecar (research/sweeps/NN-<slug>/4-spec-coverage.json)
description: Structured stage-4 artifact consumed by engine/publish-coverage.py, which prefers it over the sibling 4-spec-coverage.md when both exist. One sidecar per behaviour; its records array is exactly the set of records the publisher writes to data/coverage.json for that behaviour. The citation/coverageRecord $defs mirror data/schema/coverage.schema.json and must change with it (same-document $refs only: engine/validate_data.py's stdlib fallback cannot follow cross-file refs). This schema lives in data/schema/ -- the repo's schema registry -- but is deliberately NOT in engine/validate_data.py's CHECKS, which pair data/*.json files with their schemas; sidecars validate research/sweeps artifacts and are enforced at publish time by publish-coverage.py instead.

sidecar_version.description: Format version of this sidecar contract; currently always 1.

slug.description: The sweep directory's slug: the directory is research/sweeps/NN-<slug>/. publish-coverage.py rejects a sidecar whose slug or behaviour_id does not match the directory it sits in.

records.description: Exactly the records the publisher writes to data/coverage.json for this behaviour: one per lab, in the coverageRecord shape. Records are published verbatim -- citation key order included -- so a sidecar derived from data/coverage.json round-trips byte-for-byte.

reconstructed.description: true when this file was derived after the fact (e.g. mechanically from data/coverage.json) rather than authored as the sweep's stage-4 artifact. Every sidecar must declare this; a reconstructed one must additionally carry reconstructedFrom and reconstructedDate (enforced by publish-coverage.py, since a single-file schema cannot express the conditional).

reconstructedFrom.description: The source the records were reconstructed from, e.g. data/coverage.json @ <commit>.

note.description: What this file establishes and what it cannot -- mandatory honesty for reconstructions: which fields a genuine stage-4 artifact would carry that this one does not.

locator.description: Locator per specs/CITATION.md, resolvable by engine/spec-cite/cite.py.

quote.description: Verbatim quote: exact output of cite.py resolve for the locator.

role.description: Why this passage is evidence for the verdict.

adjacent.description: Reinforcing rather than directly on-point evidence.

example_block.description: Citation is a worked-example block; the quote stores the caption line.

coverageRecord.description: Same closed shape as data/schema/coverage.schema.json's coverageRecord: the builders consume these fields verbatim, so an undeclared key is a typo or an unreviewed field, not data.

lab_id.description: Must match an id in data/labs.json; publish-coverage.py additionally requires exactly one record per lab it publishes.

citations.description: No verdict without at least one citation (data/README.md).

verified_against_version.description: Spec version the citations were verified against, e.g. 2026-01-20. publish-coverage.py checks it equals the version pinned by the record's first locator.
